description: This file is part of the 'go-humanize' package, providing functions to format floating-point numbers into human-readable strings with customizable formatting options such as thousands separator, decimal separator, and precision.

methods.name: FormatFloat
methods.description: Formats a float64 number into a string based on a specified format string, handling special cases like NaN and Infinity, and supporting custom decimal and thousand separators, as well as precision.

methods.name: FormatInteger
methods.description: Formats an integer into a string using the same formatting logic as FormatFloat, by converting the integer to float64.
